findings.evidence: Digest at dbff837f lists 118 removed units and shows 40; the record covers the shown units, but the unlisted 78 were not judged item by item.
findings.fix: Re-run the removal check against the full para list (not the 40-item cut) and add a record row, or restore into references/, for any substantive unit the cut hid.

findings.evidence: Workflow step 5 says to deliver the full README, the changed sections, or one line per stale claim, but there is no output template or checklist for those three deliverables.
findings.fix: Add a short deliverable template for each of the three outcomes (full README, changed sections or diff, one line per stale claim with the contradicting file and value) at Workflow step 5.

findings.evidence: Gotchas cover monorepo commands, name mismatches, release vs branch, generated regions, registry rendering, anchors, HTML sanitization and badges, but not a README that documents only the happy path while CI runs extra setup the user still needs.
findings.fix: Add a Gotcha: when CI installs tools, exports secrets or runs a bootstrap before the documented command, the README must include that step or say the command is CI-only, because a clean clone otherwise fails for a reason the files do not show.

findings.evidence: Directory Structure documents the skill for humans and is not loaded by any SKILL.md step; references and templates are already gated.
findings.fix: Keep the tree in README.md for the repository. Do not add a SKILL.md load of it; no agent-facing content needs to move.

findings.evidence: Validation step 1 says to run the first-use path verbatim in a fresh clone, a new virtualenv, or a container, with no default when more than one is possible.
findings.fix: Default to a fresh clone in a temp directory; use a new virtualenv only for a language that needs one, and a container only when the README itself requires it.

findings.evidence: Eight evals and 21 trigger queries exist, but none exercises a source-available license (BUSL, SSPL, Elastic, PolyForm, Commons Clause) or a missing remote, both of which Workflow step 2 says must not be treated as OSS or Personal.
findings.fix: Add one eval whose LICENSE is BUSL-1.1 or SSPL-1.0 and assert the draft states those terms and does not call the project open source, plus a near-miss trigger query for writing a changelog or a standalone API reference.

findings.evidence: The registry-query tail cites https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v10/using-npm/config#registry, while docs/audit/upstream-sources.json records the npm config page at https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v11/using-npm/config.
findings.fix: Re-check the npm config page and cite the current docs URL with the date checked, or replace the pinned v10 URL with an instruction to read `npm config --help` / the live docs.

findings.evidence: The PyPI content-type rule cites https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/guides/making-a-pypi-friendly-readme/ and https://setuptools.pypa.io/en/latest/userguide/pyproject_config.html; neither URL is a row in docs/audit/upstream-sources.json (the registry lists other packaging.python.org and setuptools pages).
findings.fix: Add upstream-sources.json rows for those two official pages, or point the gotcha at the packaging and setuptools pages the registry already lists, keeping the checked date.
